description: Figure 2 illustrates the performance of different methods across varying chunk sizes. The x-axis is labeled “Chunk Size” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 8 to 4096, with tick labels at intervals of 8. The y-axis is labeled “Retrieval Accuracy (%)” and employs a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 42, with tick labels at intervals of 4. There are five lines displayed on the plot. The first line, colored black and solid, represents “BM25” and begins at approximately 36.7% at a chunk size of 8, decreasing to 28.2% at a chunk size of 4096. The second line, colored blue and dashed, represents “GIST” and starts at 26.5% at a chunk size of 8, declining to 21.7% at a chunk size of 4096. The third line, colored green and dotted, represents “OpenAI” and begins at 31.2% at a chunk size of 8, decreasing to 24.4% at a chunk size of 4096. The fourth line, colored red and dash-dotted, represents “GPT-4” and starts at 35.4% at a chunk size of 8, declining to 31.6% at a chunk size of 4096. Finally, the fifth line, colored orange and solid, represents “RAG” and begins at 32.4% at a chunk size of 8, decreasing to 29.3% at a chunk size of 4096.
